text:
Devin (Sales): FYI - CopperCom pilot hit an invoice problem and they asked for a one-time rebate + extended terms. Need quick approval or we risk them pausing the pilot.
Elaine (Finance): details? amounts and why we should make an exception? :thinking: 
Devin (Sales): They were charged twice for EU VAT on a single deployment day (region routing mismatch). Net effect: customer was overcharged $18,500 on Invoice INV-2024-3321. They want that amount refunded as a one-time rebate and Net60 for the rest of the pilot.
Ajay (Acct Mgmt): Short summary of the commercial ask: 1) One-time credit $18,500 2) Move to Net60 for 60 days of the pilot only 3) No future pricing changes, pilot will convert to standard ARR if we meet milestones.
Elaine (Finance): $18.5k is under the $20k manual-CFO threshold, so it can be approved by finance ops with EM approval. We need confirmation that this is a billing system error and not a pricing concession.
Devin (Sales): Confirmed — it was a tax/region routing duplicate charge. Engineering traced it to a gateway mis-tag on 2024-03-15. I can share logs if you need them.
billing-bot: Payment gateway note: duplicate tax capture flagged on txn TXN-88F2-03. Related invoice INV-2024-3321.
Elaine (Finance): Ok. Can we do a soft credit (one-off refund) and document as "tax adjustment" in ledger? Also need GL code and who gets notified for accounting.
Ajay (Acct Mgmt): GL: 6205 - Sales Credits. I'll own client comms and confirm conversion milestones after pilot.
Maria (Legal): I need a one-paragraph amendment to the pilot MSA limiting the Net60 for the pilot period only and stating no other commercial precedent. I can draft and send to CopperCom; loop in Elaine for signoff.
Elaine (Finance): Draft + GL ok. One more ask: ops needs an approval note in the ticketing system with approver name. I'll approve if Maria signs off on the limited-term clause. Approver: Elaine (Finance).
Devin (Sales): Thanks. I'll get the amendment signed and paste the signed note back here.
Ajay (Acct Mgmt): For records, invoice snippet: ```
Invoice: INV-2024-3321
Original charge: $24,200 (includes EU VAT)
Duplicate tax portion: $18,500
Credit requested: $18,500
```
Elaine (Finance): Approving contingent on signed amendment. If we have the signed doc by EOD, I'll push the refund today and mark ticket TKT-4492 resolved.
Maria (Legal): Drafted and sent to CopperCom legal. Email thread ID: copper-legal-2024-88. cc: ajay@redwood, devin@redwood.
Devin (Sales): CopperCom legal signed and returned at 16:12. I uploaded the signed amendment to the deal folder and pasted the link: https://drive.redwood/drive/pilot-coppercom/amendment-signed.pdf
Elaine (Finance): Received. Approving one-off credit $18,500 against INV-2024-3321 as "tax adjustment". Will do Net60 for the pilot only. I'll post the approval into TKT-4492 and notify accounting.
billing-bot: Refund processed: REF-2024-771. Amount: $18,500. Applied to INV-2024-3321. Status: pending settlement.
Devin (Sales): :tada: Thanks team. Will monitor conversion and close loop once the pilot converts.
Elaine (Finance): Closing note: record in finance system with code 6205, memo "one-off tax adjustment — CopperCom pilot". Marking this as non-precedent.
Ajay (Acct Mgmt): Noted. Will include clause reference in renewal docs to avoid accidental re-application.
Devin (Sales): Closing thread. Cheers.
